book.name: LUUKA
book.title: oMwazi Mwinja gwa Yeesu Krisitu nk'oku LUUKA aguyandikaga

content: Okuleka ebyaaha
Amo mango, abantu baguma bayinja kubalira Yeesu gurhe Pilaato ayirhaga aBagalilaaya baguma eyi bali gurhuula entuulo emwa Nnamahanga.
Yeesu ababwira ntya: «Mwabo muganiizize kw'abo Bagalilaaya bayirhwaga ntyo, k'okuderha oku bo baligwerhe ebyaaha binene kulusha abandi Bagalilaaya booshi?
Mbabwirire oku nangwa. Aliko nka murhalekere ebyaaha byenyu, mweshi nji mwafa kuguma nabo.
Changwa, aboola bantu ekumi na munaane omunaara gw'eSilowaamu gwarhogeraga ko, gwanabayirha, muganiizize oku boowe bo baliiri babi bweneene kulusha abandi Banyayerusaleema booshi?
Mbabwirire oku nanga. Nenyu nka murhalekere ebyaaha byenyu, mweshi nji mwafa kuguma nabo.»
Omugani g'omurhi gurhayaanaga malehe
Yeesu ashuba kubabwira guno mugani: «Haliiri muntu muguma waligwerhe omurhi guyirikwa tiini omu shwa lyaage ly'emizabiibu. Aja oku go gushonda amalehe, aliko ntaamo abwene.
Ava abwira omuhinzi w'elyo shwa ntya: ‹Lola! Myaaka esharhu eyi ndi nayinja gushonda amalehe k'oguula murhi eyi ntanamabona. Oguche! Chagarhuma gwabeera bushaabusha omu budaka?›
Aliko oyo muhinzi anamushubiza ntya: ‹Nnaweerhu, oguleke kandi guno mwaka, mpingire go n'okuguhira kw'emyaavu.
Ntyo, nkabaga nji gwaleerha amalehe omu mwaka gwayinjire, akaba birhabeere ntyo, wanagucha!›»
Yeesu afumya omukazi olusiku lw'eSaabato
Lusiku luguma lw'eSaabato, Yeesu aliiri kuyigiriza omu sinagoogi.
Ahoola haliiri omukazi olwere. Gurhengera myaaka ekumi na munaane, omuzimu alimuyinamize. Arhakagalire chiro kuyinamuka.
Yeesu abeere amubona, amuhamagala n'okumubwira ntya: «Nyaama wee, endwala yawe yafumire!»
Amuhira ko amaboko, ho n'aho ayinamuka n'okuva arhondera gukuuza Nnamahanga.

Aliko omukulu w'esinagoogi agaya oku Yeesu afumyize omuntu olusiku lw'eSaabato. Ava abwira echigusho ch'abantu ntya: «Hali siku ndarhu z'ogukola mo akaasi; mw'ezoola siku zimulemage mwayinja mo guchifumiisa, sy'aliko nangwa olusiku lw'eSaabato!»
Nnaweerhu amushubiza ntya: «Mwe ndyaalya mwe! Nkaasi muguma wenyu ashwekuula enka yaage changwa epunda yaage n'okuyiheeka gushooka olusiku lw'eSaabato, k'arhali ntyo?
N'oyuula mukazi w'obuuko bwa Abrahaamu owalizirikirwe na Shetaani myaaka ekumi na munaane, ka birhahemere ashwekuulwe mw'ebyo biziriko byaage olusiku lw'eSaabato?»
Yeesu abeere ali kuderha ntyo, booshi baliiri kumulwisa bayunva eshonyi; aliko echigusho chooshi ch'abantu chamogera ebijiro binja byooshi aliiri kujira.
Ogushushanya oBwami bwa Nnamahanga
Yeesu ashuba kuderha ntya: «oBwami bwa Nnamahanga bwagashusha na gichi? Nankabushushanya na gichi?
Bushusheene n'ehiburho hy'eharadaali
muntu muguma arhoolaga anahibyaala omu shwa lyaage. Hyaamera n'ogukula, hyaaba murhi, n'enyunyi z'omu chaalege zayumbaka ebyoogo byaazo omu marhabi maago.»
Yeesu ashuba kuderha ntya: «Gichi nankalinganya n'oBwami bwa Nnamahanga?
Bulinganeene n'echachu omukazi arhoolaga n'okuyihira omu milengo esharhu y'eshaano y'ogukola emigati, kugera egihe yooshi yarhunda.»
Omulyango gufundereere
Yeesu aliiri omu njira aja eYerusaleema, alenga omu bishagala bineneenene n'ebigeekegeeke ayigiriza.
Muntu muguma amubaza ntya: «Nnaweerhu, k'arhali bantu bageeke bonyine nji bachungulwa?» Yeesu ashubiza ntya:
«Muchihangaane kuja omu Bwami bwa Nnamahanga kugerera omu mulyango gufundereere. Bulaala, yi nababwira, bantu banene nji bashonda kuja mo aliko barhakagala.

Amango nyina enju nj'aba ayimangire ey'amanachinga omulyango, nji mwaba mwamasigala embuga. Nji mwarhondera gukongoorha oku mulyango n'okuderha ntya: ‹Nnaweerhu, orhuchinguulire.› Nj'abashubiza ntya: ‹Mwabo, ntenji muli ba ngahe.›
Ho n'aho, nji mwamubwira ntya: ‹Rhwaliire rhwananywa haguma naawe, wanagendaga wayigiriza emwerhu!›
Naye nj'ababwira ntya: ‹Ntenji muli ba ngahe. Muje hale naani, mweshi mwe mukola amabi!›
Eyoola nji yaaba amalira n'oguhekenya amenyo
, amo mango nji mwabona Abrahaamu, Isaka na Yakobo, n'abaleebi booshi omu Bwami bwa Nnamahanga, aliko mwabo nji mwaba mwakabwirwe embuga!
Abantu nji barhengera ebuhulukiro bw'ezuuba n'ebuzikiro bwalyo, n'abandi gurhengera emalambo n'egarhongo n'okuyikala balye haguma omu Bwami bwa Nnamahanga.
Mumenye oku hali abazinda nji baaba barhanzi, hali n'abarhanzi nji baaba bazinda.»
Yeesu alakira Yerusaleema
Mw'ebyoola bishanji, aBafarisaayo baguma bayegeera Yeesu n'okumubwira ntya: «Rhenga hano, ochigendere ahandi, bulaala Heroode yashonda gukuyirha.»
Yeesu abashubiza ntya: «Mugende mujibwira ogoola mutereri ntya: ‹Yi nalibisya abazimu n'ogufumya abalwala zeene n'omuseezi. Na lishinjo naamala akaasi kaani.›
Aliko bihemere ngendekere olugenzi lwani zeene, omuseezi na lishinjo, bulaala birhakwaneene kuyirhira omuleebi ahandi aharhali eYerusaleema.»

«Yerusaleema, Yerusaleema, wooyo weyirha abaleebi n'okubanda amabaale abantu Nnamahanga agurhumiraga! Kanga nashondaga guhira haguma abaana baawe nk'oku engoko ehira haguma ebyaanagoko byaayo omu byuubi byaayo! Aliko murhabilonzaga.
Mumenye okw'enju yenyu yaaba mushaka. Mbabwirire byo: murhagachimbona kugera amango hayinja egihe nji mwaderha ntya: ‹Nnamahanga agishe owayinja oku ziino lya Nnaweerhu!›»

footnotes.text: 13.19 Eharadaali guli murhi guyeera k'orhuburho rhugeekegeeke bweneene.
13.28 Eyi nderho ederhere okw'abantu nji baaba embuga nji baaluba n'okuyongwa omu kubona obushagaluke bw'abeera ba Nnamahanga.
